data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small adverse prioryear reserve movement: gross prior year claims reserves increased by approximately GBP 0.06m (about 3.2% of opening gross reserves), a strengthening driven by adverse claims development related to elevated and uncertain catastrophe exposure. The movement is attributed to ongoing uncertainty around prior catastrophe events (notably 2017 US hurricanes and Californian wildfires) which produced modest upward adjustments to older year estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 0.1m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2017: release of GBP 0.2m).

In 2018, there has been an overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 0.1m (2017: surplus of GBP 0.2m) due primarily to an increase in claims estimates from uncertainty around 2017 catastrophe exposure unwinds.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was derived from the gross claims development triangle (notes) since no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' table with a gross figure was presented. The report states a net deterioration of GBP 0.1m (net of reinsurance) for prior years; the gross triangle indicates an increase of GBP 0.06m for 2016. All triangle figures are shown in the notes in GBP '000. RITC commutations and the funds-withheld arrangement with Syndicate 2791 are noted in the report and may distort inter-syndicate movements; confidence in the gross triangle extraction is moderate-high.
